what.text: This page follows refugees from Syria living in Italy, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 2871 Syrian refugees in Italy, 0.1% of all refugees from Syria.
Türkiye hosts the most Syrian refugees, followed by Germany, Lebanon and Jordan.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Syria from 1979 to 1982 and in every year from 2011 to 2025.
It also records armed conflict with the Islamic State group in Syria from 2013 to 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1981 at 5 refugees.
The figure was at its highest, 4781, at the end of 2019; the main years of displacement in the data are 2016 to 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Italy.
These are year-end totals for Italy only, reported to UNHCR.
